The outlined treatment plan for Alice's Type 2 diabetes is highly appropriate and aligns with standard clinical guidelines. The combination of lifestyle modifications—specifically a low glycemic index diet and regular moderate-intensity exercise—addresses the root causes of insulin resistance and helps manage weight. Daily blood sugar monitoring provides essential data for both the patient and provider to understand how the body responds to diet, exercise, and medication. Metformin is widely considered the first-line pharmacological therapy for Type 2 diabetes due to its efficacy, safety profile, and ability to improve insulin sensitivity. Finally, scheduling follow-up appointments every three months is standard practice to monitor HbA1c levels, adjust treatments as necessary, and check for potential complications or side effects.
